photos.caption: Wooded valley and green hillside below distant buildings at Jawhar
photos.author: Star Dust H

spots.name: Sunset Point
spots.summary: An unhurried evening looking across the wooded valley. Go before sunset and keep time for the return.

spots.name: Hanuman Point
spots.summary: Valley views and a distant view of Jai Vilas Palace. A gentle sightseeing stop rather than a packed itinerary.

spots.name: Dabhosa waterfall
spots.summary: A possible daytime outing. Flow changes after the monsoon; ask locally about access and current conditions.

stays.name: Rama Inn, Jawhar
stays.summary: Small hotel with family rooms and vegetarian meals. Ask which rooms are quiet and whether your group can stay together.

photos.caption: Camping on Don hill — landscape photograph
photos.author: Wandering eon

spots.name: Don village
spots.summary: Take in the open hill landscape and village surroundings in daylight. Ask a local host about suitable walks.

spots.name: Don village waterfall
spots.summary: A seasonal stop, not a guaranteed flowing waterfall in October or November. Check locally before making a detour.

stays.name: Ahwa family homestays
stays.summary: Use Ahwa as a possible base. Confirm an actual room booking, meals and the distance to Don before travelling.

stays.name: Green Oraa Homestay, Ahwa
stays.summary: A map listing to investigate. Current operation, group capacity and the setting have not been verified.

photos.caption: Rippled sand beside a calm sea and a tree-lined shore at Bordi
photos.author: Sanjaybhagwat

spots.name: Bordi beach
spots.summary: A long shoreline walk and sunset. Keep the day relaxed rather than filling it with activities.

spots.name: Gholvad chikoo orchards
spots.summary: Ask your host to arrange an orchard visit; these are working farms and permission matters.

spots.name: Aswali Dam
spots.summary: An optional outing offered by a local homestay. Confirm the route and access with your host.

stays.name: Florian Homestay, Bordi
stays.summary: A family-run Parsi bungalow opposite the beach. It can be upscale: ask for a group quote and room arrangements.

spots.name: Ninai waterfall
spots.summary: The main forest outing, around 35 km from Dediapada according to the district guide. Confirm access and water flow locally.

spots.name: Dediapada countryside
spots.summary: Keep a daylight drive around your stay as the simpler backup. Ask locally about suitable public stops and forest restrictions.

stays.name: Hotel Rameshwar, Dediapada
stays.summary: Town hotel and restaurant, useful as a simple base rather than a forest stay. Confirm current rooms, prices and parking directly.

photos.caption: Two people standing at the water’s edge as waves roll onto Guhagar beach
photos.author: Mahendra5806

spots.name: Guhagar beach
spots.summary: Make this the main evening outing: a slow coastal walk, sunset and dinner at the stay.

spots.name: Velaneshwar beach
spots.summary: A nearby coastal outing with a beach and temple. Pick one outing rather than rushing between stops.

spots.name: Hedvi coast
spots.summary: An optional coastal detour. Ask your host about the best access and current conditions.

stays.name: Mauli Nivas, Guhagar
stays.summary: A homestay in a house, with two first-floor units described by the owner. Ask about beds for 6–7, meals and total charges.
